flow_bookmarklet_title: Drag this onto your bookmarks bar, or right-click it and bookmark the link
flow_curve_keep_exact: Every member keeps the exact same level and XP. This server switches from the {curve} curve.
flow_curve_keep_levels: Members keep their levels and progress on the {curve} curve. Their XP numbers change.
flow_drop_file: Drop the file here or choose one
flow_error_bad_key: That key was rejected. Check it was copied in full.
flow_error_busy: Another import is already running on this server.
flow_error_empty: No members were found in that data.
flow_error_generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
flow_error_global_currency: This bot shares one balance across every server, so balances cannot be imported into one server.
flow_error_job_missing: That import expired. Read the data again.
flow_error_leaderboard_private: This server's MEE6 leaderboard is private. Make it public in MEE6's dashboard, then try again.
flow_error_not_found: The other bot has no data for this server.
flow_error_not_ready: That import is not ready yet.
flow_error_rate_limited: The other bot is limiting requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.
flow_error_source_failed: The other bot did not answer properly. Try again in a few minutes.
flow_error_unreadable_file: That file could not be read. Use a JSON or CSV export with a user ID and an XP or level for each member.
flow_error_wrong_kind: That data does not match. XP sources need XP or levels, and UnbelievaBoat needs balances.
flow_error_wrong_server: That file was exported from a different server. Run the export on this server's MEE6 dashboard.
flow_import_roles_hint: Sets the same role for each level here. Existing roles on those levels are replaced.
flow_intro: Moving from another bot? Bring your members' XP, levels, level roles and balances with you. You see everything before it is written, and an import can be undone for 24 hours.
flow_mee6_instructions: Drag Export from MEE6 onto your bookmarks bar, or right-click it and bookmark the link (Firefox and Vivaldi offer this, Chrome and Edge need the drag). Then click the bookmark while your server is open on mee6.xyz. You can also copy the script and paste it into the console there (Ctrl+Shift+J, or Cmd+Option+J on a Mac). Your MEE6 login stays in your browser and is not part of the file.
flow_settings_intro: Pick what to bring over. Names already in use and deleted channels or roles are skipped. Reaction roles keep working on MEE6's messages, while button menus are posted again by Mewdeko.
flow_source_amari_how: Apply for an Amari API key. Amari sends it to you in a DM, usually within a day. Paste it below.
flow_source_arcane_how: Arcane has no export. Open your server's leaderboard on arcane.bot, scroll until every member is loaded, run the export script in the browser console and upload the JSON it saves.
flow_source_file_how: Any JSON or CSV with a user ID for each member and an XP, level, cash or bank value.
flow_source_lurkr_how: Export your levels from Lurkr and upload the JSON file it gives you.
flow_source_mee6_how: Make the leaderboard public in MEE6's dashboard (Leveling, Leaderboard), then read it here. Nothing else is needed.
flow_source_mee6settings_brings: Welcome messages, level settings, custom commands, reaction roles, filters, Twitch alerts and the shop
flow_source_mee6settings_how: On a computer, open your server on MEE6's dashboard and run the export below, either from your bookmarks bar or pasted into the browser console. It downloads a file with your settings, which you upload here.
flow_source_polaris_brings: XP, plus level roles and your curve with the Everything export
flow_source_polaris_how: On Polaris' website, open your server and download your XP. Any format works. Pick Everything to bring level roles too.
flow_source_tatsu_how: Run t!apikey create in any channel. Tatsu sends you a key in a DM. Paste it below.
flow_source_unbelievaboat_how: Create an application on UnbelievaBoat's site, authorize it on this server from the application's page, then paste its token below.
flow_sync_roles_hint: Gives every imported member the roles for their level. Takes a while on big servers.
flow_undo_hint: You can undo this for 24 hours.
page_history_empty: Nothing has been imported into this server yet.
page_undo_expired: That import can no longer be undone.
page_undo_message: Every member it changed goes back to what they had before. Anything they earned since the import is lost.
